6	/**
7	 * Railway health check endpoint.
8	 *
9	 * Called by Railway on every deploy before marking the service healthy.
10	 * Must respond in < 1 second.
11	 *
12	 * Returns 200 when all checks pass, 503 when any check fails.
13	 */
14	export async function GET() {
15	  const checks: Record<string, string> = {
16	    web: 'ok',
17	    db: 'unknown',
18	  }
19	
20	  try {
21	    const supabase = await createClient()
22	    const { error } = await supabase.from('_health').select('id').limit(1).maybeSingle()
23	    checks['db'] = error ? 'fail' : 'ok'
24	  } catch (err) {
25	    logger.warn({ err }, 'health check db ping failed')
26	    checks['db'] = 'fail'
27	  }
28	
29	  const allOk = Object.values(checks).every((v) => v === 'ok')
30	
31	  return Response.json(
32	    {
33	      status: allOk ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
34	      checks,
35	      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
36	      version: process.env.RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID ?? 'local',
37	    },
38	    { status: allOk ? 200 : 503 }
39	  )
40	}

1	# InkOS — Rollback Procedures
2	
3	## Automated Rollback (Railway)
4	
5	Railway automatically rolls back if the healthcheck fails after deploy.
6	
7	**Trigger:** `GET /api/health` returns 503 or times out (100s timeout)
8	**Action:** Railway reverts to the previous successful deployment automatically
9	
10	## Manual Rollback (Bolt runs this)
11	
12	### Web Service Rollback
13	```bash
14	# List recent deployments
15	railway deployments --service web
16	
17	# Roll back to a specific deployment
18	railway rollback --deployment DEPLOYMENT_ID --service web
19	
20	# Or roll back to previous deployment
21	railway rollback --service web
22	```
23	
24	### Database Migration Rollback
25	
26	Migrations are tracked in `supabase/migrations/`. To roll back:
27	
28	```sql
29	-- Sprint 0 rollback (run in Supabase SQL editor)
30	-- WARNING: This deletes all data in these tables
31	
32	-- 1. Drop triggers first
33	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
34	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS profiles_updated_at ON public.profiles;
35	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS studios_updated_at ON public.studios;
36	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS studio_members_updated_at ON public.studio_members;
37	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS locations_updated_at ON public.locations;
38	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS subscriptions_updated_at ON public.subscriptions;
39	
40	-- 2. Drop functions
41	DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS auth.user_studio_ids();
42	DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.handle_new_user();
43	DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.handle_updated_at();
44	
45	-- 3. Drop tables in reverse FK order
46	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.webhook_events;
47	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.audit_log;
48	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.subscriptions;
49	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.locations;
50	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.studio_members;
51	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.studios;
52	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.profiles;
53	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public._health;
54	```

57	
58	- Railway status: https://status.railway.app
59	- Supabase status: https://status.supabase.com
60	- Dodo Payments status: https://status.dodopayments.com

64	Each sprint adds a new migration. Rolling back a sprint means:
